trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 50 degrees and a vertical depth comprising 10 percent of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations creating a jagged silhouette against the sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges transitioning to a concave trailing edge sweep, terminating in pointed tips oriented upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of roughly circular, yellowish-brown pixel formations on the dorsal/posterior region of the tail stock near the fluke insertion point.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Observation of a dark, high-contrast linear filament (entanglement) draped across the dorsal surface of the fluke and through the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive water-droplet spray artifacts creating high-intensity pixel noise along the trailing edge and fluke tips.
